questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of titanium are used in the manufacturing of all commercial aircraft delivered globally by aerospace manufacturers in a single year?
reasoning: Major aerospace manufacturers deliver approximately 1500 commercial passenger aircraft worldwide per year.
A large modern wide-body and narrow-body mixed commercial fleet averages about 15 metric tonnes of titanium per airframe.
Multiplying 1500 aircraft by 15000 kilograms gives 22500000 kilograms, plus additional smaller regional and cargo jets brings the total to roughly 25000000 kilograms.

questions.prompt: How many total individual blades of grass are growing across all manicured lawns at residential homes in the state of California?
reasoning: California has roughly 10 million residential homes, and about half of them possess a typical suburban lawn averaging 400 square metres.
A square metre of healthy manicured residential lawn contains approximately 200000 individual blades of grass.
Multiplying 5 million lawns by 400 square metres yields 2 billion square metres of total lawn area.
Multiplying 2 billion square metres by 200000 blades per square metre results in 420000000000000 total blades of grass.

questions.prompt: How many total individual cloves of garlic are harvested by all commercial garlic farms across Spain in a single year?
reasoning: Spain produces roughly 280000 metric tonnes of garlic annually as one of the world's leading exporters.
An average kilogram of garlic contains about 40 individual bulbs, and each bulb typically consists of 10 to 12 cloves.
Multiplying 280000 tonnes by 40 bulbs per kilogram yields 11200000000 bulbs.
Multiplying 11200000000 bulbs by an average of 12.5 cloves per bulb gives approximately 140000000000 individual cloves.
